scope: Read-only source and saved metadata review; original architecture review preserved, no global document or candidate/source/device/model changes.

contracts_checked.raw_tap: Original immutable 640-byte PCM after original endpoint.feed; denoised FFT output is not fed to CTC.
contracts_checked.capture_queue: Original 8 frames/160ms unchanged; observed peak3, error empty, reader closed.
contracts_checked.ctc_isolation: One separately spawned CTC process, one model/stream, one thread, normal nice0; observer performs no decode or blocking socket send.
contracts_checked.credit: Offer increments pending before sender queue/socket; only ordered exact-count ACK after accept+drain releases samples. Queued+sent+unACKed count is real, not reset on send.
contracts_checked.final: END carries source sample count/hash; worker checks before flush; result requires all prior ACKs.
contracts_checked.device_database: Probe calls _read_pcm on paced public source, never capture.start; process_factory refuses arecord. No SQLite/Store/identity/device write calls. Guard reads process/config and HTTP state/health metadata; public output excludes dialogue bodies.
contracts_checked.cleanup: Source/pump/endpoint and private socket threads are closed in finally, own CTC wait/terminate/kill is bounded. Actual root runner adds120s own-new-session process-group timeout/cleanup; no production PGID signalled.

interpretation: 未发现单位换算、重复计数或GTCRN变长输出被混作RAW计数的问题。第154帧offer超过固定1秒未确认预算，失败有效。
oldest_ack_max_ms只统计已经收到ACK的offer→ACK最大时长843.141ms；不是失败时最老未ACK的当前年龄，不能拿它证明所有在途帧均不足1秒。
child在DATA触发is_ready时同步完成decode后才ACK；未ready帧则可立即ACK。这会产生模型块状峰值。当前结果证明共存条件下传输/处理确认延迟超预算，尚不能区分平均算力不足、首轮/块decode、CPU调度、ACK线程延迟。
失败时没有child的decode调用wall/processCPU与进行中阶段报告。隔离4轮9次decode总3.2–3.52秒wall/2.75–2.86秒CPU、单次max约0.408–0.476秒，不足以替代本次共存测量。
不提前ACK、不增credit、不扩大原queue8。当前1秒是外部transport预算，不能声称覆盖模型内部已接受但尚未ready的全部上下文或等于端到端延迟。
runnable_conditions: As a bounded public diagnostic only: exact source/model pins, paused production microphone/no task or playback, current boot/PID/birth guards, four-core normal-priority parent, dependency versions and memory margin, plus the root-owned finite process-group runner. No production-readiness or accuracy pass follows.
source_timing_caveat: The3s parent reader timeout starts before frontend construction/warmup. An initialization exceeding3s can fail this diagnostic before first data; this did not cause the observed154-frame credit overflow.
deployment_decision: 小CTC不替换：质量/输出差异尚未获得可接受的准确率结论，且本次共存credit预算失败。按root指令不继续小CTC追测；正式原ASR3线程/27B/OmniVoice16/v14保持。
